name: ModifyHadoopDataSource

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Service description, with a maximum length of 256 characters
parameters.help_zh: 服务描述，长度最长为256字符
parameters.name: data_source_description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

*   mysql

- postgresql

*   hdfs

- hive
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型，取值：

- mysql/postgresql

- hdfs/hive
parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the external service. Valid values:

*   emr: E-MapReduce (EMR) Hadoop cluster.
*   selfCreate: self-managed Hadoop cluster
parameters.help_zh:
外部服务创建类型：

- emr：emr实例

- selfCreate：自建
parameters.name: hadoop_create_type

parameters.help_en: The IP address and hostname of the Hadoop cluster (data source) in the /etc/hosts file
parameters.help_zh: Hadoop集群源节点在/etc/hosts文件中的地址和hostname
parameters.name: hadoop_hosts_address

parameters.help_en: The content of the Hadoop core-site.xml file
parameters.name: hadoop_core_conf

parameters.help_en: The content of the Hadoop hdfs-site.xml file. This parameter must be specified when DataSourceType is set to HDFS
parameters.help_zh: Hadoop hdfs-site.xml文件内容。在选择开通HDFS外表时，该字段必填
parameters.name: hdfs_conf

parameters.help_en: The content of the Hadoop hive-site.xml file. This parameter must be specified when DataSourceType is set to Hive
parameters.help_zh: Hadoop hive-site.xml文件内容。在选择开通HIVE外表时，该字段必填
parameters.name: hive_conf

parameters.help_en: The content of the Hadoop yarn-site.xml file. This parameter must be specified when DataSourceType is set to HDFS
parameters.help_zh: Hadoop yarn-site.xml文件内容。在选择开通HDFS外表时，该字段必填
parameters.name: yarn_conf

parameters.help_en: The content of the Hadoop mapred-site.xml file. This parameter must be specified when DataSourceType is set to HDFS
parameters.help_zh: Hadoop mapred-site.xml文件内容。在选择开通HDFS外表时，该字段必填
parameters.name: map_reduce_conf

parameters.help_en: When HadoopCreateType is Emr, the value of this field is the EMR instance ID
parameters.name: emr_instance_id
